messages:
morgan: Quick preflight/dry-run at 18:00 UTC. We're roleplaying a short canary (10% -> evaluate -> abort). Goal: rehearse rollback paths, confirm ACLs, and validate runbook wording. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference-canary-revert

jen: I'll run the smoke-dry suite and post pass/fail. Oncall 17:50. ✅

sam: I'll run the dashboard synth and a spike generator to simulate regressions. Will post the dashboard link T-5.

maria: I'll be decision owner for the drill. Proposed abort criteria for the drill: p99 >30% over baseline for 2m OR error rate >0.8% for 2m OR sample-output mismatch. Agree?

alex: Confirming I can execute both rollback methods (flag toggle & deploy rollback). I'll do a dry-run first.

ci-bot: dry-run job queued: `ci run smoke --env=canary --dry-run` 

morgan: Also test region toggles and ensure we have a fallback path if ffctl is unavailable.

alex: Running ffctl dry-run: `ffctl set inference_canary true --dry-run` -> OK. Attempting real toggle to verify perms...

alex: Real toggle attempt -> 403 Forbidden: missing scope "region:write".

jen: I can run the toggle if needed; I have elevated ffctl token for today. But we should fix ACLs long-term.

alex: I'll open ACL ticket: ACL-482 to grant ffctl region:write to SRE-oncall. For the drill today we'll prefer deployctl if ffctl fails.

sam: Synthetic spike generator started against canary endpoints at 18:03. Generating artificial 5xxs and latency spikes. Dashboard link: https://dd.internal/d/infra/sim-canary-176777

ci-bot: smoke-dry-run result: PASSED (artifact: https://ci.internal/builds/85321)

jen: Smoke dry-run PASS: health 5/5, sample prompts 10/10 match baseline, embeddings checksum OK.

sam: Observing sim metrics now: p99 +120% for ~90s, 5xx rate ~0.9% sustained.

maria: Those numbers hit the drill abort criteria. I'm calling abort for this rehearsal. Alex, please execute rollback path.

alex: Doing deployctl rollback dry-run first: `deployctl rollback inference-service --to-tag=stable-2026-03-12 --dry-run` -> OK. Executing real rollback...

alex: Rollback executed: `deployctl rollback inference-service --to-tag=stable-2026-03-12` -> completed.

sam: Metrics trending back toward baseline; errors dropping to 0.05%, p99 decaying. Expect transient p95 bump while caches warm.

jen: Noted the ffctl permission failure. I'll add an addendum to the runbook: prefer deployctl if ffctl returns 403 and include the ACL ticket link.

morgan: Nice dry-run. Action items from drill: 1) ACL-482 (alex) to grant ffctl region write to oncall; 2) runbook addendum (jen) to document ffctl fallback; 3) schedule real canary window next week (morgan).

ci-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled: meeting invite created for 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC (post-drill retro).

maria: Great rehearsal. Short notes: keep messages concise during real deploy, call abort early.

jen: Will draft the runbook change and ping infra for ACL.

alex: I'll link ACL ticket here once created.

morgan: Thanks team. We'll close loop on ACL + runbook before next window. Keep this thread for follow-ups only. :lock:
